coauthors.name: Omar Elshehy
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Rejected. arXiv record shows only AraModernBERT (Arabic encoder pretraining), QARI-OCR (Arabic OCR via multimodal LLM), plus unrelated experimental quantum-optics papers (2301.06091, 2312.14805). Arabic language modeling and OCR are multilingual NLP, with no cultural awareness, cultural values or value-alignment component.

coauthors.name: Omer Nacar
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Only email printed in the AraModernBERT PDF author block. Relevant: co-author of arXiv 2505.21979 'Pearl: A Multimodal Culturally-Aware Arabic Instruction Dataset' - the title itself commits to 'Culturally-Aware' Arabic instruction data - and of arXiv 2503.00151 'Palm: A Culturally Inclusive and Linguistically Diverse Dataset for Arabic LLMs', a community-built dataset explicitly framed as 'Culturally Inclusive' across Arab countries. Both go beyond building an Arabic model: they target cultural coverage/awareness of LLMs, which is the cultural-values dimension the list is about.
